business.title: Maya's Program Office
business.description: The program-management function Maya runs for a software delivery team: keeping leadership informed and keeping client programs moving.

lobs.title: Program Delivery Services
lobs.description: Running the team's client programs from kickoff to delivery, and reporting on them.

functions.title: Program Management
functions.description: Owns program tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder communication.

processes.title: Program Delivery
processes.description: Tracking active programs week to week and reporting their status to leadership and stakeholders.

workflows.title: Weekly Status Report
workflows.description: Drafts the Friday leadership status report from the team's project tracker — progress, blockers, and next week's focus — ready for Maya's review by 10am.
workflows.trigger: Manual — Maya starts it Friday mornings

workflows.title: Stakeholder Meeting Prep
workflows.description: Assembles the agenda, open decisions, and talking points for each stakeholder meeting from the team's recent activity. A prep brief Maya skims and corrects.

notes.title: Status report scope grows a section at a time
notes.description: Leadership started asking for risks, and Maya added the section by hand twice before the template caught up — watch the run log's Edits column for the next one.
